hypotheses.what_changed: External counterevidence makes a three-part admission gate explicit: observability/decodability, intervention reliability/selectivity, and incremental verified outcome/control value must be measured separately.
hypotheses.hypothesis: A latent feature should enter Frank runtime control only when it passes all three gates on matched held-out/OOD data and remains evidence/authority separated.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: No latent feature adds enough incremental control value over existing receipts/readouts to justify runtime cost and fragility.
hypotheses.falsifier: Existing system readouts match or beat LCOP-augmented control under equal budgets, or latent interventions fail selectivity/transfer.

hypotheses.what_changed: A fresh 2026 native-model workspace analogue makes the hypothesis more concrete, while causal-probing critiques make architecture analogy insufficient.
hypotheses.hypothesis: NativeModelWorkspace should remain an observational latent plane unless the NativeModelWorkspace x ClayGWT factorial shows reproducible non-additive or separable causal value without overcoupling/resource dominance.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The two workspaces are redundant or antagonistic; one should remain observational or be omitted.
hypotheses.falsifier: No incremental outcome/receiver-use/re-entry/diversity benefit after additive/common-driver controls.

hypotheses.what_changed: Fresh target evidence shows duplicate-safe deterministic folding is not enough to identify currentness under concurrent source mutation; external snapshot/exactly-once systems independently support binding a read frontier to derived output. Late-arrival coordination further forbids a private reward epoch and binds reward currentness to the shared UnifiedDB lineage/checkpoint successor.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Every mutable authoritative-derived Frank projection that can be consumed as CURRENT must bind the exact shared authoritative source lineage/checkpoint and event frontier/snapshot it covers; otherwise it is STALE/PREFIX/evidence-only.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A machine-enforced frozen-checkpoint topology can make explicit frontier metadata redundant.
hypotheses.falsifier: Writer-exclusion proof plus adversarial concurrency tests show no possible prefix-current ambiguity without explicit frontier identity.

hypotheses.what_changed: SLSA independently supports verification-at-use against expectations, but does not justify one universal internal schema. The hypothesis is split into a mandatory semantic rule and an optional shared implementation primitive.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Consumer-side verification of identity/epoch/authority binding is mandatory at consequential boundaries, but a single common CBPC implementation is promoted only if it beats branch-local typed guards on the common fault matrix.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Only branch-local contracts should exist; a shared primitive creates harmful coupling.
hypotheses.falsifier: Shared primitive has no coverage/recovery advantage or causes higher false rejection/complexity defects than local guards.

hypotheses.what_changed: Large-scale personality instability evidence weakens psychometric/persona scores as persistent state truth and strengthens timescale/authority separation.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Frank should represent owner-fixed identity, contextual persona, fast appraisal and slow regulatory state separately; psychometrics remain audit projections and never identity/effect authority.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Prompt-only persona plus immutable identity contracts provides equivalent longitudinal behavior with less state complexity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Prompt-only persona equals factorized state on restart/OOD continuity, warranted adaptation, drift, calibration and outcome quality under matched cost.

hypotheses.what_changed: External quantization work shows representation-sensitive failure modes but does not prove universal transfer failure; therefore require per-probe transfer evidence instead of blanket assumptions.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent probe/control artifacts are exact-model/build/quantization/basis scoped by default and may gain an explicit transfer certificate only after matched pre/post intervention and OOD validation.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Most selected probes transfer robustly enough that strict build scoping is unnecessary.
hypotheses.falsifier: Broad pre/post build study shows stable calibration/selectivity/actionability across declared build classes with negligible failure rate.

hypotheses.what_changed: Latent feature non-identifiability gives Hyperposition a concrete narrow use-case: preserve competing equivalent mechanistic explanations without promoting one label to truth.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Hyperposition is most valuable as a bounded unresolved-equivalence structure for latent/route hypotheses when simpler pairwise projection would create false certainty.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Weighted pairwise/factorized alternatives preserve the same uncertainty and decisions at lower cost.
hypotheses.falsifier: Pairwise baseline matches decision regret/calibration/OOD transfer and preserves provenance under descriptive collisions.

hypotheses.what_changed: Current upstream SQLite documentation confirms the exact WAL-reset vulnerability range and trigger topology, sharpening the acceptance fork.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Frank may use WAL persistence only when the exact loaded SQLite object is proven fixed/backported or a machine-enforced topology proves the multi-connection concurrent writer/checkpointer trigger unreachable.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Current Ubuntu build already contains the needed backport despite its version family.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact source/build attestation or targeted fault test proves the loaded target library fixed.

hypotheses.what_changed: Concurrent research split build trust into non-substitutable axes and locally falsified a signer/repository/workflow-only verifier with an artifact-subject swap.
hypotheses.hypothesis: ProductStart build trust is conjunctive: trusted producer/source policy, cryptographic verification, exact attested subject digest, local installed-byte equality, and admitted state-lineage/recovery identity must each hold; trusted signer/workflow identity cannot substitute for exact artifact subject binding.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: An owner-controlled deployment channel plus exact local artifact hash is sufficient for v0.1 and a general attestation verifier adds needless machinery.
hypotheses.falsifier: A simpler owner-pinned deployment design provides equal producer/source authenticity, subject binding, revocation/rotation and restart recovery under subject-swap and stale-artifact faults.

hypotheses.what_changed: A final late-arrival negative line showed that identical raw digest bytes can be paired with incompatible semantic-root protocol/manifest meanings. The selected lineage head therefore needs a domain-separated typed checkpoint identity, not a bare hash.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic continuity must bind SemanticCheckpointIdentity(root_protocol, semantic_root_manifest_id, semantic_root_hash) plus lineage/sequence/parent, and authoritative admission must originate from an independent checkpoint producer rather than caller-selected labels.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Typed fields only relocate the authority leak if protocol/manifest/root remain caller-selectable or share the same rollback failure domain.
hypotheses.falsifier: SEMANTIC_ROOT_DOMAIN_CROWN_SWAP must reject same-digest incompatible domains, followed by producer-admission and rollback tests on the exact target path.

hypotheses.what_changed: A final late-arrival local falsifier showed that inherited PATH can shadow a helper such as dirname and execute code before the intended absolute Python -I -S guard starts, while still returning a correct path.
hypotheses.hypothesis: The trusted ProductStart boundary begins before the first executable/helper resolution: pre-admission helpers, PATH, launcher bytes and interpreter invocation must be fixed/attested so no untrusted executable runs before the Clay/SQLite admission guard.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The current launcher environment is sufficiently trusted in production, making additional pre-Python fencing redundant.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target-run PRE_GUARD_PATH_DIRNAME_HIJACK and installed service restart must show zero hostile pre-guard execution with exact launcher/manifest binding.
